integrity: The complete proof and a standalone exhaustive verification program are included; the program checks finite cases and cannot certify asymptotic theorems. Originality carries stated literature-access and unindexed-result risks.
scientific_limitations: Uniform iid fixed-q source; only radius-one simultaneous disjoint adjacent swaps. The published antirun ball formula and arithmetic mean are used as inputs, not presented as novel. No claims about optimal codes or decoding performance. Independent audit not performed.
title: Quenched ball entropy, Gaussian fluctuations, and large deviations for the limited-permutation channel
